_meta.description: Statistical methods documentation: thresholds, formulas, references

gpd.description: Generalised Pareto Distribution fitted to exceedances above a threshold using maximum likelihood estimation (mev::fit.gpd).

ci_methods.delta: Delta method (asymptotic normal approximation of MLE)
ci_methods.bootstrap: Block bootstrap (block_size=48h) with 500 resamples; percentile CIs at 95% level

references: Coles, S. (2001). An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values. Springer.
Beirlant, J. et al. (2004). Statistics of Extremes. Wiley.

mann_kendall.description: Non-parametric trend test using Kendall's tau correlation between time index and variable values.
references: Mann, H.B. (1945). Nonparametric tests against trend. Econometrica, 13, 245-259.
Kendall, M.G. (1975). Rank Correlation Methods. Griffin, London.

stl_decomposition.description: Seasonal and Trend decomposition using Loess (STL). Separates time series into seasonal, trend, and remainder components.
stl_decomposition.frequency: daily (24 observations per cycle for hourly data)
stl_decomposition.references: Cleveland, R.B. et al. (1990). STL: A Seasonal-Trend Decomposition Procedure Based on Loess. J. Official Statistics, 6, 3-73.

rogue_wave_detection.description: Rogue waves detected where Hmax exceeds 2x significant wave height (Hs).
references: Haver, S. (2004). A possible freak wave event measured at the Draupner jacket January 1 1995.
Kharif, C. & Pelinovsky, E. (2003). Physical mechanisms of the rogue wave phenomenon. Eur. J. Mech. B/Fluids, 22, 603-634.

gust_factor.description: Ratio of gust speed to mean wind speed. Rogue gusts exceed a threshold factor.
gust_factor.references: WMO (2018). Guide to Meteorological Instruments and Methods of Observation. WMO-No. 8.

cross_correlation.description: Cross-correlation between station pairs at varying lags, used to identify wave propagation patterns.
cross_correlation.references: Hasselmann, K. et al. (1973). Measurements of wind-wave growth and swell decay during JONSWAP. Dt. Hydrogr. Z., A8(12), 1-95.
